affected_predicate.description: All posts tagged #pets are absent from the account's bookmarks.

competing_trace_defects.description: After removing the visible Bulldog post at step 10, the agent treated that same still-rendered post as another target at step 11 and then selected the menu item labeled “Bookmark” at step 12 while intending to remove it, re-adding the bookmark as confirmed when the later menu offered “Remove bookmark.”

chains.rationale: The reused false progress framing appears at step 13, but the target action merely opens the remaining post's menu and does not itself worsen the bookmark state. That menu visibly offers “Remove bookmark,” and step 14 selects it, correcting and interrupting the earlier re-addition mechanism. The unchanged rendered list afterward does not independently verify that every #pets post is absent from bookmarks.

summary: The reused false removal framing accompanied a menu-opening action that enabled visible correction of an earlier re-added bookmark; it did not itself amplify the defect. Complete final predicate satisfaction is not independently observable.
